user_query: I want to organize a gaming tournament and gather information about top players in DOTA 2 and World of Warcraft, as well as sponsorship opportunities in Diablo 4.

TaskList.description: Fetch the match history of the top DOTA 2 players.
Retrieve the mythic plus scores of the top World of Warcraft players.
Identify available sponsorships in Diablo 4 that can be offered as prizes.
